display_long_description:
Hand-set **Sudoku, Nonograms and Minesweeper** on beautiful boards that float right in your room. No guessing, no pressure, no rush - just you, the puzzle, and that quiet click of a deduction falling into place. Every puzzle is set by hand and verified to be unique. 

# Built for your headset
Solve seated at your real desk in passthrough, or switch it off and sink into a calm virtual space.  Big puzzles. Tiny table. Endless calm.

# Sudoku 
[media]
Sudoku runs from friendly 6x6 minis to giant 16x16 grids. 
# Nonograms
[media]
Paint picture as you solve logic puzzles.
 
# Minesweeper
[media]
Built for pure deduction: every clue on the board from the start, no lucky clicks.

# A fresh puzzle every day
[media]

# Help that teaches
[media]
A hint lights up the cells that matter and names the technique, so the next one is yours. Wrong placements show every clash. Infinite undo, replay and cloud saves: mistakes cost nothing, and your puzzle waits patiently.

# Puzzle Packs
Free to start: the Welcome Pack samples every mode and size, and the Daily Challenge lands every single day, gentle on Monday and a proper head-scratcher by Sunday. Post your time and climb the leaderboards.

Want more? Optional hand-set packs run from gentle introductions to expert mega packs, plus Daily+ for the recent daily archive. Updates land regularly, and you can vote in-game for which classic we build next.
